visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Animation begins with a yellow cartoon dog sleeping on its stomach on a white background. Small blue cat-bug creatures (Capoo) fall from the top of the frame and stack themselves one by one on the dog's head. The dog's eyes remain closed and its expression is neutral. (2) The stack of blue creatures grows taller, extending beyond the frame. The background shifts to a wide shot of a small red-roofed house on a green hill under a white sky with clouds. The blue stack emerges from the house's chimney like a tall tower. (3) The scene transitions to outer space, where a cartoon Earth with a face looks surprised. The blue stack extends from Earth into the dark blue sky, reaching a smiling moon. The moon has a light yellow surface with craters. (4) The topmost Capoo on the stack leans forward and kisses the moon, creating a small red heart icon. The moon's expression changes from happy to intensely blushing and then exploding with red energy. (5) The moon transforms into a fiery red orb and crashes down toward Earth. Earth's face expresses extreme shock. A white rabbit character (Tutu) appears on the green grass, transforms into a giant muscular version of itself, and catches the falling moon. (6) The muscular rabbit repeatedly punches the fiery moon back into space while the dog and other Capoos watch from the ground. (7) Final scene displays a blue background with many Capoos stacked in a pile. The text 'Capoo Stack' appears above them with App Store and Google Play icons at the bottom.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: Capoo Stack. (2) [Slogan]: Capoo Stack. (3) [Slogan]: Download on the App Store. (4) [Slogan]: GET IT ON Google Play.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: No real humans, only animated characters.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: Multiple blue animated 'Bugcat Capoo' characters, a yellow dog character, and a white rabbit character.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Alternates between a plain white background, a stylized green hill with a house, and an outer space background with Earth and Moon.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Video begins with a bright, cheerful 8-bit style synthesizer BGM. High-pitched percussive 'boing' and 'thud' SFX occur each time a Capoo character lands on the dog's head, perfectly synchronized with the visuals. (2) As the stack grows, a rising 'whoosh' synthesizer effect signifies rapid vertical movement. (3) A magical 'sparkle' or bell sound effect plays when the heart appears after the kiss. (4) A loud, distorted explosion boom follows as the moon turns red. (5) Heavy, rhythmic comic-style punching sounds occur as the rabbit strikes the moon. (6) The BGM continues throughout the final game branding screen, ending with a final percussive note.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Escalation -> Climax -> Resolution -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional advertisement for a mobile game titled 'Capoo Stack'. It uses a humorous and surreal narrative involving popular internet mascot Bugcat Capoo to demonstrate the stacking mechanic of the game before prompting viewers to download it.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video ends with a full-screen display of the game title, platform download icons, and a search bar, which are standard advertising elements.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video utilizes a high-energy audiovisual synchronization typical of mobile game advertisements targeting young audiences.
